name: dager-hunter
description: Android-friendly offline fantasy hack-and-slash action RPG playable MVP.

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/game.js && node --check src/core/audio.js && node --check src/core/input.js && node --check src/core/save-system.js && node --check src/core/utils.js && node --check src/data/content.js && node --check src/entities/entities.js && node --check src/systems/procedural-forest.js && node --check src/ui/ui.js && node --check tools/build-single-file.js
scripts.android:copy-assets: npm run pc:build && cd android && gradle --no-daemon syncWebAssets
scripts.android:apk: npm run pc:build && cd android && gradle --no-daemon assembleDebug
